title: Aeromatic: Cafe in the Sky
description: Explore the Skylands with Gliders and Airships
body:
## Build an Airship, Explore the Skylands, Master the Skies

![Aeromatic Title Card, reading Aeromatic: Cafe in the Sky](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c81a48523bdd044e2960e770e2805d0dca743812.png)
![Isometric view of the sky islands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/77Q6jk4I/images/829c3fedb9a70d46829578664aa8a5c18b8a8c7f.png)

This pack combines the impressive landscapes of [Aetherial Islands](https://modrinth.com/mod/aetherial-islands) with the potential of [Create: Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) to give you a wide open world perfectly suited for sky travel!

### Airships

This modpack has an assortment of Create addons to further enrich your Aeromatic journey.
- [Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons), bringing battle straight to the skies! Collect a crew, and pillage the heavens together!
- [Create Escalated](https://modrinth.com/mod/escalated), the perfect way to bring players up to any landing platform
- [Ars Creo](https://modrinth.com/mod/fZ324GMc) and [Applied Kinetics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-applied-kinetics), helping bridge the gaps between Create and Ars Nouveau and Applied Energistics
- [Create Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco), adding further customization to those ships bound for the skies

### Casual Play

More interested in settling down? There's plenty of furniture and farming mods for you to make any island your home!
- [Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted)
- [Another Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture)
- [Let's Do Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/lets-do-furniture)
- [Cluttered](https://modrinth.com/mod/cluttered)
- [Croptopia](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/croptopia)
- [Let's Do Vinery](https://modrinth.com/mod/lets-do-vinery)
- [Kaleidoscope Cookery](https://modrinth.com/mod/kaleidoscope-cookery)
- [Kaleidoscope Tavern](https://modrinth.com/mod/kaleidoscopetavern)

### Play With Friends

Aeromatics is intended as a social experience, with in-game [voice chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat), the ability to send [mail](https://modrinth.com/mod/envelope) to your friends, [Exposure](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure) to document your adventures, and additional mods to assist with server administration!
<details>
<summary>Server Admin Mods</summary>
  
- [Chunky](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky) for pre-generating the world
- [Grief Logger](https://modrinth.com/mod/grieflogger)
- [Maintenance Mode](https://modrinth.com/mod/maintenancemode)
- [Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr)
</details>

Enjoy exploring these vast skylands, find new flowers and mushrooms from [Serene Shrubbery](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-shrubbery) and [Mushroom Quest](https://modrinth.com/mod/mushroom-quest), document the flora and fauna with [Field Guide](https://modrinth.com/mod/field-guide), and progress through a **full questline** created using [QuestLog](https://modrinth.com/mod/questlog)!

![Screenshot of the in-game questlog, accessed by pressing `](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/77Q6jk4I/images/02a06a101661f52e601648a11aabf11a81bc1c6b.png)


**Plus plenty more to find and explore!**

maybe even an alternate sky dimension...
